answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 257 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the jade. The atlas index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the inlet queue while genuine members promoted earlier continues earning. A 75 account operation therefore ties up 26 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
